verdict.rationale: Column is an API-first bank. Its docs cover programmatic bank account management, a unified endpoint for querying transfers across payment types, and transaction and summary reports in JSON. The API is published as an OpenAPI spec, and a probe confirmed both openapi.json and an llms.txt are live, so an agent can read accounts and transactions without screen-scraping. Pending activity is only implied by transfers placed in a 'hold' state, and monthly statements are produced but nothing shows they can be retrieved through the API. missing for 10: an explicit way to read pending or held activity, documented API retrieval of statements and other documents, an MCP server, and independent hands-on corroboration of agent read access.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can read the full banking picture — accounts, transactions, pending activity, documents — through a clean API or MCP surface without screen-scraping a dashboard

citations.quote: Programmatically open and manage FDIC insured bank accounts at Column on behalf of your customers.
Query transfers across all payment types from a single unified endpoint.
Column provides the following reports: `bank_account_transaction` and `bank_account_summary`. All reports are available in CSV, JSON, and Parquet formats.
Column's API is defined by an OpenAPI spec (also available as JSON).
